lines.zh: 击碎者大步走来，脚步很沉
lines.en: Thrasher comes on in heavy strides.
Its body is tall enough to block the light.
Each step sinks the soil.
Its long arms hang at its sides.
It turns to squeeze past a tree.

lines.zh: 它的头随步伐一低一抬
lines.en: Its head dips and lifts as it walks.

lines.zh: 它走过的地方草都倒了
lines.en: The grass lies flat where it passes.

lines.zh: 它沿着你的方向稳步前进
lines.en: It advances steadily your way.
Its breathing is rough.
It surges, then slows.
Thrasher stands with arms hanging.

lines.zh: 它把重心在两只脚间换
lines.en: It shifts weight foot to foot.
Its shoulders swell and settle.
It lifts a hand and looks at it.
Its claws open and close.
It lowers its head as if listening.
One foot scrapes the ground.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸让胸前起伏很大
lines.en: Its breathing lifts its chest hugely.
It suddenly straightens up.

lines.zh: 它的喉咙里滚出一声低吼
lines.en: A low growl rolls in its throat.

lines.zh: 它抬起胳膊，试了试关节
lines.en: It raises an arm and tests the joint.

lines.zh: 它站着，像一座会动的岩壁
lines.en: It stands like a moving cliff.
There is no hesitation in its eyes.

lines.zh: 它把一条腿往前挪半步
lines.en: It moves one leg half a pace.

lines.zh: 它的重量让地上留了印
lines.en: Its weight leaves prints.
It turns its head, scanning around.
Thrasher looks down at you.

lines.zh: 它把你和它自己的手比了比
lines.en: It compares you to its own hand.
Its head tilts.
It steps in half a pace, looming.
Its claws spread at its side.

lines.zh: 它发出一声短促的低吼
lines.en: It gives a short growl.

lines.zh: 它用指节敲了敲自己的胸口
lines.en: It knocks a knuckle on its chest.
It does not look hurried.
It raises a hand and points.
It waits for your response.

lines.zh: 它把你归为可以应付的东西
lines.en: It files you under manageable.

lines.zh: 它向前倾了一点，肩膀压低
lines.en: It leans in, shoulders low.

lines.zh: 击碎者晃了一下，退了半步
lines.en: Thrasher sways and gives half a step.

lines.zh: 它的皮上多了一道白痕
lines.en: A pale line shows on its hide.

lines.zh: 我喘乱了一拍，随即低吼。
lines.en: My breath stumbles once, then I growl.
It presses a hand to the wound.
Its growl deepens.
It resets its balance.
It knocks the ground with its knuckles.

lines.zh: 我看了看伤口，又盯住你。
lines.en: I glance at the wound, then fix on you.
It gives half a step, and no more.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛没有离开过你
lines.en: Its eyes have not left you.

lines.zh: 击碎者看了一眼你手上的东西
lines.en: Thrasher glances at what you hold.
It simply reaches and takes it.
It holds it up to the light.
It squeezes it, testing how hard it is.

lines.zh: 它对食物没有太大兴趣
lines.en: Food does not much move it.
It tosses it back to you.
It reaches for a second.
It tucks the thing at its hip.
It nods, accepting.

lines.zh: 它的注意力很快又回到你身上
lines.en: Its attention swings back to you.
You hit Thrasher like a wall.
It hardly moves.
It brushes you aside with a hand.
You stagger back several steps.
Its leg scrapes across your shoulder.
Its leg brushes your shoulder.
It shifts aside, grudgingly.

lines.zh: 它的重量让地面陷了一点
lines.en: The ground gives under its weight.

lines.zh: 它站稳，重新把重心压低
lines.en: It settles and drops its weight again.
It takes no offence.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，地面下沉。
lines.en: Side by side, we sink the ground.
They bump shoulders.
Their breathing slowly syncs.

lines.zh: 一只抬手，另一只也抬手
lines.en: One raises an arm; the other does too.
They press foreheads.

lines.zh: 它们的低吼合成一个音
lines.en: Their growls merge into one note.
Back to back, each watches a side.

lines.zh: 地面被它们踩出两个坑
lines.en: Two pits mark where they stand.
They hold like that a long while.

lines.zh: 荒地上一时没有别的动静
lines.en: Nothing else stirs in the waste.
Thrasher stoops and picks it up.
It holds it between two fingers.

lines.zh: 它把东西在掌心转了转
lines.en: It turns it over in its palm.
What it does not want, it crushes.
It tucks the item at its hip.

lines.zh: 它把战利品举起来晃了晃
lines.en: It lifts the prize and shakes it.
It barely bends to take it.
One look and it discards it.
It presses the item into the soil.
Then it straightens again.

lines.zh: 击碎者的肩膀沉了下来
lines.en: Thrasher's shoulders drop.
Its weight rolls to the front foot.

lines.zh: 地面被它一顿，尘土跳起
lines.en: Its stomp kicks dust up.

lines.zh: 它的喉咙里滚出一声闷吼
lines.en: A deep growl rolls in its throat.
It raises both hands into a stance.

lines.zh: 我的爪子全张开，你挑一边。
lines.en: All my claws spread — pick a side.
It locks you dead centre.
It leans forward as if to spring.
The muscles in its legs bunch.
It starts closing in.

lines.zh: 它每一步都比上一步近
lines.en: Each step lands closer than the last.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸变得又深又慢
lines.en: Its breathing turns deep and slow.

lines.zh: 它的影子先把你的退路盖住
lines.en: Its shadow covers your exits first.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴扫倒了身后的小树
lines.en: Its tail takes down a sapling behind it.
It sinks its weight as low as it goes.

lines.zh: 它忽然跳了一下，又落地
lines.en: It hops once and lands.
That landing digs a crater.
It is ready.
Thrasher circles you.
Slow steps, and certain.
It keeps shortening the gap.
It presses in from the side.
A hand lifts and falls.
It waits on your move.
You retreat; it follows.
It turns broadside and blocks the way.
Its eyes never leave you.
It drops into a crouch and loads.
Its claws dig into the soil.

lines.zh: 地面在它脚下裂了细缝
lines.en: Fine cracks spread under its feet.
It growls and steps in.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸声贴着你的耳朵
lines.en: Its breathing is right at your ear.

lines.zh: 它已经缩到最短的距离
lines.en: It has closed to the shortest range.
The next step is the strike.
It decides to stop waiting.
It drops its body sharply.

lines.zh: 它忽然半蹲，像随时要跳
lines.en: It half-crouches, ready to leap.
It raises one hand past its shoulder.
Thrasher sweeps an arm across.

lines.zh: 它的拳头砸在你护甲上
lines.en: Its fist slams your armour.
It leaps and comes down claws first.
It knocks you off your feet.

lines.zh: 它抓住你的肩往地上按
lines.en: It grips your shoulder and drives you down.

lines.zh: 它的掌拍下来，地面裂开
lines.en: Its palm cracks the ground.
Its tail sweeps your legs.
A knee drives into your middle.
The miss switches hands at once.
It bears down with all its weight.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在你袖上撕开一口
lines.en: A claw tears your sleeve open.
It backs half a step and crouches again.
Breathing rough, it still watches.

lines.zh: 它用指节敲了下自己胸口
lines.en: It knocks a knuckle on its chest.

lines.zh: 地面先传来沉重的震动
lines.en: The ground shakes first.

lines.zh: 击碎者从尘雾里走出来
lines.en: Thrasher walks out of the dust.

lines.zh: 它把挡路的树直接推开
lines.en: It shoves a whole tree aside.
Gravel grinds underfoot.
It straightens, and it is very tall.
Its breath blows the dust away.

lines.zh: 它抬起一只手，试了试关节
lines.en: It lifts a hand and tests the joint.

lines.zh: 它的影子落下，荒地暗了
lines.en: Its shadow falls and the waste darkens.
It scans as it walks.

lines.zh: 它的低吼从胸腔深处来
lines.en: Its growl rises from deep in its chest.

lines.zh: 它把地面踩出深深脚印
lines.en: Deep prints follow its feet.
It halts at the centre of the clearing.
It turns its head your way.
It huffs out a rough breath.
It brings both hands up.
Its claws open in the air.

lines.zh: 它把身体重心压到最低
lines.en: It sinks its weight as low as it can.
It starts charging at you.
Its footfalls drown out everything.

lines.zh: 荒地上一时只剩这一个声音
lines.en: Only that sound is left in the waste.

lines.zh: 皮毛被燎，它抖了一下身子
lines.en: Singed hide makes it shake itself.

lines.zh: 落地时它单膝砸进了土里
lines.en: It lands and a knee punches the soil.
Chest-deep, it still drives upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我这三格高的身子推着滑了几格。
lines.en: The blast slides my three-block body back a few blocks.
An arrow sinks in its shoulder and quivers.
Odd force enters; it growls once.

lines.zh: 饿着打，它的动作慢了一拍
lines.en: Fighting hungry, its timing slips.

lines.zh: 雷击让它僵了一下，又撑住
lines.en: Lightning locks it a moment; it holds.

lines.zh: 虚空拽它，它用爪子抓地
lines.en: The void pulls; its claws bite the ground.
